description: Car-2-X WLANp Road Side Unit RSSI is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. Der Datensatz liefert die zu erwartende Signalstärken (RSSI) von Car-2-X Kommunikationsinfrastruktur (WLANp Standard), platziert an Unfallschwerpunkten mit PKW Beteiligung aus dem Jahr 2018 (Daten aus Unfallatlas). Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. Its tags are mcloud_id8206cc6f-c52b-4dc7-b6e0-aab683e614d5, mfund-fkz-19f2033e, mfund-projekt-cartox. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTPS://W3ID.ORG/MDP/SCHEMA/FILE_MEDIA_TYPE#ANY_OTHER_MEDIATYPE. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
